title.en: Practical 8: Photosynthesis (test tube and funnel experiment, demonstration)

text.en: Bubbles rising from a pondweed prove that plants release oxygen.

The aim is to prove that oxygen is evolved during photosynthesis. The materials are a test tube, a funnel, a beaker, pond water and Hydrilla.
Put twigs of Hydrilla in a beaker of pond water, cover them with an inverted funnel and invert a water-filled test tube over the funnel stem. Keep it in sunlight for some hours.
After an hour water is displaced from the test tube by the gas collected. A burning stick brought near the mouth glows brighter, proving the gas is oxygen. Hence oxygen is given out in photosynthesis.
